post_freeze_amendments: 2026-06-06 P3.03: S7 AABB adjusted (min_x 2.04 -> 2.039, max_x 2.09 -> 2.089) so in_plane_gap is 0.039 instead of the exact 0.04 boundary, and expected_distance_m updated from 0.05 to 0.049204. Semantic class unchanged (Phase 2: near, Phase 3: near); purpose unchanged (proves polygon mode combines normal_gap and in_plane_gap via hypot while remaining within threshold). Rationale: float64 hypot(0.03, 0.04) projected through the plane-local basis lands at 0.05000000000000003, which fails the <= 0.05 threshold check. Moving slightly off the boundary preserves the hypot-arithmetic intent without depending on exact-IEEE-754 luck; adding an extractor epsilon was rejected because it would silently change Phase 2 byte-equality semantics.

policy.rationale: Phase 2 A3 default; S8 fallback case uses a non-synth surface (source=mesh_ransac) with polygon=null per Phase 3 A7 option (a).

synthetic_room_convention.description: Right-handed frame with gravity = -z. Synthetic room is a 2x2x2 m cube spanning x,y,z in (0, 2). Floor at z=0 (interior-facing normal +z), north wall at y=2 (interior-facing normal -y), east wall at x=2 (interior-facing normal -x), ceiling at z=2 (interior-facing normal -z). Plane equation a*x + b*y + c*z + d = 0; (a,b,c) is the interior-facing normal.

cases.rationale: rug on the floor; AABB straddles floor plane and is well inside floor polygon footprint. Real Replica data; grounds the fixture. Numeric gap fields omitted because the canonical bundle is the source of truth for this entity's AABB.
Entity AABB straddles wall plane (y from 1.85 to 2.05 contains y=2) and lies fully within wall polygon extent in plane-local (x, z) coords. Both modes: NEAR.

AABB sits entirely above floor (min_z=0.02), so normal_gap=0.02 (NOT straddling). Footprint (5..5.1, 5..5.1) is 3*sqrt(2) m from polygon corner (2,2), so in_plane_gap = sqrt(18) ~= 4.2426. Final = hypot(4.2426, 0.02) ~= 4.2427. Phase 2 mode: NEAR (bbox_to_plane=0.02 <= 0.05 floor threshold). Phase 3 mode: NOT_NEAR (distance_m=4.2427 >> 0.05).

AABB straddles wall plane (y 1.95..2.05 contains y=2). In plane-local (x, z) the AABB projects to (x=5..5.1, z=0.9..1.1). Wall polygon spans x=0..2, z=0..2; closest polygon point in (x,z) is (2, z in 0.9..1.1), in-plane distance 3.0. Final = hypot(3.0, 0.0) = 3.0. Phase 2 mode: NEAR (normal_gap=0). Phase 3 mode: NOT_NEAR (3.0 >> 0.30 wall threshold).

AABB max_z=1.99 below ceiling plane z=2.0 (normal_gap=0.01 <= 0.10 ceiling threshold). Footprint (5..5.1, 5..5.1) is 3*sqrt(2) m from ceiling polygon corner (2,2). Final = hypot(4.2426, 0.01) ~= 4.2426. Phase 2 mode: NEAR (normal_gap=0.01). Phase 3 mode: NOT_NEAR.

AABB footprint (1.9..2.1, 0.5..0.7) partially overlaps floor polygon (0..2, 0..2) at x in (1.9, 2.0); in_plane_gap = 0. AABB min_z=0.02; normal_gap=0.02. Final = 0.02. Both modes: NEAR (0.02 <= 0.05). Exercises the boundary-overlap branch of dist_2d (overlap detected via vertex-in-polygon check).
Far from both plane (min_z=10) and polygon. Sanity check: both modes correctly say NOT_NEAR. Numeric gaps omitted because the case asserts boolean only.

Hypot arithmetic case (post-P3.03 amendment — see post_freeze_amendments header). AABB min_z=0.03 above floor (normal_gap=0.03). Footprint (2.039..2.089, 0.95..1.05) is 0.039 m past polygon edge x=2 in plane-local x; in_plane_gap=0.039. Final = sqrt(0.039^2 + 0.03^2) ~= 0.049204, comfortably below the 0.05 floor threshold (no longer depends on exact hypot(0.03, 0.04) landing at 0.05 in IEEE 754). Phase 2 mode: NEAR (bbox_to_plane=0.03 <= 0.05). Phase 3 mode: NEAR (distance_m ~= 0.049204 <= 0.05). Asserts numeric evidence (normal_gap_m, in_plane_gap_m, distance_m) to catch hypot-combination regressions; no longer asserts threshold-boundary FP behavior.
